title: Kits
body:
# KitsByPriyme

KitsByPriyme is a modern kit plugin with a clean GUI, full in-game kit management, cooldowns, permissions, previews, and personal kit sorting for players.

## Player Features

- Open the kit menu with `/kit`, `/kits`, or `/k`
- Claim kits from the GUI
- Claim kits directly with `/kit <name>`
- Preview kits before claiming
- Sort kit items personally before claiming
- Save a custom kit layout per player
- Reset personal kit sorting anytime
- Permission based kit access
- Cooldowns for every kit
- Premium styled kit lore
- Rarity stars
- Custom kit icons
- Custom kit names and descriptions
- Armor and offhand items are included in kits
- Exact inventory slot layout when claiming kits
- Fully configurable messages
- Fully configurable GUI title, size, filler, and lore style

## Admin Features

- Open the admin menu with `/kit admin`
- Create kits from your current inventory
- Edit kit contents in a dedicated editor menu
- Import your current inventory into the kit editor
- Save armor slots and offhand items
- Move kits in the menu by dragging them
- Delete kits with a confirmation menu
- Rename kits
- Clone kits
- Change kit cooldowns
- Change kit rarity stars
- Change kit permissions
- Change kit menu slots
- Change kit icons from the item in your hand
- Enable or disable icon glow
- Edit kit action lines
- Reload all plugin files in-game
- Modrinth update notifications for operators
- bStats support

## Commands

### Player Commands

`/kit`  
Opens the main kit menu.

`/kits`  
Opens the main kit menu.

`/k`  
Opens the main kit menu.



## Personal Sorting Menu

`Click an item`  
Selects the item.

`Click another slot`  
Moves or swaps the selected item.

`Green Candle`  
Saves your personal sorting.

`Chest`  
Resets your personal sorting.

`Red Candle`  
Cancels without saving.

## Admin Commands

`/kit admin`  
Opens the admin GUI.

`/kit reload`  
Reloads config, messages, kits, cooldowns, and menus.

`/kit edit <name>`  
Opens the kit item editor.

`/kit admin create <name> <cooldown> <rarity>`  
Creates a new kit from your current inventory.  
Example: `/kit admin create vip 15min 3`

`/kit admin delete <name>`  
Opens the delete confirmation menu.

`/kit admin delete <name> confirm`  
Deletes a kit instantly.

`/kit admin rename <old_name> <new_name>`  
Renames a kit.

`/kit admin clone <source_name> <new_name>`  
Copies an existing kit into a new kit.

`/kit admin cooldown <kit> <cooldown>`  
Changes the kit cooldown.  
Examples: `60s`, `15min`, `1h`, `1d`

`/kit admin rarity <kit> <stars>`  
Changes the rarity stars of a kit.

`/kit admin permission <kit> <permission>`  
Changes the required permission for a kit.

`/kit admin permission <kit> default`  
Restores the default permission.

`/kit admin permission <kit> none`  
Removes the required permission.

`/kit admin slot <kit> <slot>`  
Changes the kit position in the menu.

`/kit admin icon <kit>`  
Sets the kit icon to the item in your hand.

`/kit admin glow <kit> <on|off>`  
Toggles the glow effect on the kit icon.

`/kit admin action <kit> <available|cooldown|locked> <text>`  
Changes the action text shown in the kit lore.

`/kit admin edit <kit>`  
Opens the kit item editor.

## Permissions

`kits.admin`  
Access to admin features.

`kits.reload`  
Access to `/kit reload`.

`kits.bypass`  
Claim every kit and ignore cooldowns.

`kits.no.cooldown`  
Ignore kit cooldowns.

`kitsbypriyme.claim.<kit>`  
Permission for a specific kit.
